capabilities.en: Distorts After Effects layers along mask paths, following the mask shape precisely.
Used for animating text, shapes and complex elements with organic, smooth distortions.

limitations.en: No free version and no free trial identified on the official listing.
Requires Adobe After Effects; not a standalone application.

reason.en: Another After Effects plugin suite adding motion and distortion effects to the same host application.
Third-party After Effects plugin addressing complex animation workflows.
After Effects plugin for adding motion presets, targeting the same motion designer audience.
